title: Determine whether GP input authors independent display duration
scope: Investigate Beat.overrideDisplayDuration applicability before adding a public field.
acceptance: Find a pinned Guitar Pro importer assignment and valid source fixture, or establish that the field belongs to other formats.
Distinguish displayed duration from authored rhythmic duration and derived playback duration.
Record a scope disposition or a concrete implementation follow-up with an independent fixture.

reproduction.instructions: Find a pinned Guitar Pro importer assignment and valid source fixture, or establish that the field belongs to other formats.

evidence.detail: Public Beat has one duration plus exact timing.
out-of-scope: overrideDisplayDuration is populated by MusicXML rather than GP3-GP8; no independent GP record is evidenced.

Record the pinned MusicXML assignments to overrideDisplayDuration and the absence of GP3-GP8 importer/writer mappings. Update the capability scope and documentation association so this other-format field is not counted as a missing Guitar Pro authored feature; keep rhythm/dots/tuplets and exact timing coverage intact. Resolve after the evidence and scope disposition are checked. A future implementation requires an independently authored GP display-duration record, not a derived timing placeholder.
